pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

7. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   D. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Treat Insurance as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
